**Implementation note:** Long-only basket form. The single-ETF version is the Ultimate strategy's capitulation-close reversal sleeve (ultimate-algorithm.md L11).

## Description

Buy recent losers and sell recent winners over short horizons, often using prior-week or prior-month returns.

## Where it may fit

Short-horizon overreaction and liquidity-driven reversals; may fail during strong momentum regimes.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short funds and factor portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time stock universe, daily returns, liquidity/turnover, delisting returns, borrow fees and costs.

## Caveats

Microcaps, trading costs, taxes and the momentum crash can dominate apparent historical effects.
